_comment: D-A12-2: the mechanism this app uses to reproduce the Obermeyer et al. (Science, 2019) label-choice failure on synthetic data. Synthea generates realised cost from utilisation with no differential access by race, so an unmodified cohort would show no cost/burden divergence — a null result, not a finding. This factor is applied to realised utilisation and spend only, never to the underlying illness-burden signal (ACTIVE_CONDITION_COUNT), for the target stratum. Every page that shows the label-choice experiment must disclose this file and its values.
